annotations.title: Put someone in your own role

description: Put a contact in a relationship role the user named themselves, one that is not a standard type (client, prospect, investor, colleague, friend and the rest are not for this tool). Use it when the user says so in plain words ('Dana is a mentor', 'put Sam under Board'). The role becomes its own wedge on their Connections map; it is made if they do not have it yet. Get object_id from search_graph_objects.

role_name.description: The role in the user's words, e.g. 'Mentors'.
